newsitem.title: USA: Texaco USA chief to head coordinating unit.
newsitem.headline: Texaco USA chief to head coordinating unit.

text.p: Texaco Inc said Wednesday a Global Business unit, which will coordinate its upstream and downstream operations, will be led by Glenn F. Tilton, 48, senior vice president of Texaco Inc and currently president of Texaco USA.

He will be named president of Global Businesses and head a unit which will include two new global business units designed to benefit from special emphasis and attention. The Global Businesses unit will be based in Harrison, N.Y., and will include the following:
Oversight responsibility for Texaco's interest in the Caltex Petroleum Co, Texaco's downstream joint venture with Chevron Corp ;

While discussions continue with Shell Oil Co and Star Enterprise about a possible downstream U.S. alliance, the Texaco U.S. Downstream and oversight of Star Enterprise, Texaco's joint venture with Saudi Refining Inc., will be included in this unit;

Worldwide Gas and Power, a new unit to be headed by Thomas M. Matthews, 53, vice president of Texaco Inc and vice president of Texaco Natural Gas Inc, which also will include the former Alternate Energy Division;
Worldwide Lubricants, a new unit to direct the efforts of Texaco and affiliate units worldwide in the lubricants business. A leader of this unit will be named in the near future;
The worldwide operations of Texaco Fuel and Marine Marketing and International Aviation Sales; and

Technology, which will include the units dedicated to both upstream and downstream businesses, as well as the Information Technology Department. This unit will be headed by Ronald J. Robinson, 50, now president of Texaco's Technology Division.
